analysis: CHANGELOG.md only: documentation changes. Head lines 3-11 add an "Unreleased — Bedrock review and conditional merge clearance" section covering an OpenRouter budget with daily and per-attempt caps, a restricted scanner checkout, and Bedrock review with an OpenRouter fallback plus optional merge clearance. Medium/high findings, incomplete scans and review-control changes require an independent formal security override (line 10). The section describes review-tooling and CI policy, which the threat model puts out of scope (GitHub Actions/R2 release supply chain). It does not touch coordinator, provider, attestation, encryption, billing or App Attest code paths. The base excerpt (lines 1447-1717) is older release-note history, and I saw no changed security behaviour there. Head lines 13-226 are retained entries describing earlier changes (0.9.19 SSD write budget, frozen legacy MDM cohort, soft-delete mutation gate defaulting to false, account erasure, provider-bound field minimization). They are consistent with the existing threat model text (TB-009 frozen cohort, T-059 erasure, T-058 diagnostics). I found no new attack surface, invalidated assumption or threat-model gap from this diff. Coverage limit: only the first 226 head lines and the tail base excerpt were visible, so the middle of the file was not reviewed. Cloud and merge-policy activation is stated as a separate verified rollout, and I made no claim about live configuration. A later pass should check the actual workflow and script changes elsewhere in the PR (not supplied here) for reviewer-bypass and secret-handling issues.
